# Offline JSON Dependency

- Library: dkjson 2.8, David Heiko Kolf.
- Source: https://dkolf.de/dkjson-lua/dkjson-2.8.lua
- Retrieved: 2026-09-14.
- SHA-256 of the unmodified vendored file:
  `eb3bf160688fb395a2db6bc52eeff4f7855a6321d2b41bdc754554d13f4e7d44`.
- License: MIT; complete copyright and license are retained in `dkjson.lua`.
- Purpose: offline recording-bank JSON interoperability tests. No network,

- Do not edit the dependency locally; update the upstream version, source/hash,
